base.paper-0: App canvas, the deepest manila. Page ground behind every card. Folded with paper-1 in #1128. Text 15.6:1 (ink-0).
base.paper-1: Standard page paper; same value as paper-0 since #1128. Kept because 58 rules read the name.
base.paper-2: Raised card and cell fill; the plain stamped card ground. Text on it: ink-0 16.6:1, graphite 5.4:1.
base.paper-3: Brightest inset (a revealed value). Also text-on-ink-bright.
base.paper-cream: Cream knockout on ink: the name tab, the lead tile value, the rank mark on ink. 14.5:1 on ink-0.
base.ink-0: Darkest ink: headings, the 2px stamped edge, the hard offset shadow, the name tab fill and the lead tile fill.
base.ink-1: Primary ink: body text on paper-0 and paper-2 (13.5:1 on paper-2). Same value as navy.
base.ink-2: Soft ink: secondary text, tile captions on the tint tile (7.1:1 on field-wash).
base.graphite: Pencil: captions, table head labels, fact labels. 5.0:1 on paper-0, 5.4:1 on paper-2. On field-wash it is 4.52:1, only just over the floor, so a tint tile caption takes ink-2.
base.graphite-soft: Placeholder and "not available" text (fact__na). FLAG: 3.1:1 on paper-2, under the 4.5:1 text floor. Kept exact from the source; use it only for non-essential placeholders, never for a figure.
base.rule: Faded pencil grid rule; text-on-ink-dim (10.0:1 on ink-0).
base.rule-soft: Hairline rule between facts and table rows; text-on-ink-soft (12.3:1 on ink-0). The canvas hairline is the same value.
base.rule-grid: Graph-paper grid lines; blends into the canvas.
base.field: Outfield green: positive, links, focus ring. 5.3:1 on paper-0, 5.6:1 on paper-2.
base.field-mint: Light outfield green that carries ink text: the count badge on the current jump-bar button and the position pill. Read it through accent-tint. 8.4:1 with ink-0.
base.field-wash: Tint of a stamped stat tile (surface-stamped-tint). Greener and deeper than field-soft.
base.clay: Infield clay, seam red: outs, losses, alerts. 5.05:1 on paper-2. Under AA on a picked row; use clay-deep there.
base.clay-deep: Deeper clay: the loss colour on a picked row, hover on a clay button.
base.navy: Ink doubles as brand primary: the house band fill and accent-primary.
base.marker: Highlighter yellow. Rank emphasis and flags use this, never seal (ADR-0083). The rank mark is ink-0 on a marker stroke, 10.7:1.
base.marker-deep: Hatch stripe of the on-hold tape. ink-0 on it is 7.5:1.
base.seal: Kraft amber. Means sealed and nothing else (ADR-0083): only where a tap can reveal a score. Never for rank, flags or decoration. Text on it is seal-ink.
base.seal-hatch: Diagonal hatch line on a sealed cover.
base.seal-ink: Text and icon on a sealed cover: 5.4:1 on seal, 4.5:1 on seal-hatch.
base.bg-page: The ground a card sits on; one colour with bg-canvas.
base.surface-card: Card, cell and jump-bar item fill.
base.text-heading: Headings, stat labels and values, jump-bar item text. On bg-canvas, surface-card, field-wash, field-mint and marker.
base.text-body: Body copy and table figures on surface-card and bg-canvas.
base.text-muted: Secondary text on surface-card, bg-canvas and field-wash.
base.text-caption: Captions, labels and table heads on bg-canvas and surface-card (not on field-wash: use text-muted).
base.text-on-ink: Text on an ink fill: the current jump-bar item, the band title.
base.text-on-ink-cream: Text on the name tab and the lead tile value (ink fill).
base.text-on-ink-bright: Brightest paper text on a dark fill.
base.text-on-ink-soft: Soft paper text on a dark fill.
base.text-on-ink-dim: Dim paper text on a dark fill: the lead tile label and caption.
base.border-rule: Pencil rule: sheet cards, table frames, ruled section heads.
base.border-hairline: Hairline: the 1px rules between facts and above each table row.
base.border-stamped: The 2px edge of a stamped card and the colour of its hard offset shadow.
base.border-stamped-soft: The soft shadow under an ink tile, where an ink shadow would not show.
base.surface-stamped-ink: Fill of the ink tone (the lead tile) and the name tab.
base.accent-primary: The app own primary. Jump bars and tab bars stay on the app colours, never a club colour (ADR-0030).
base.accent-link: "See all" links and text buttons. 5.3:1 worst case on paper.
base.accent-tint: Count badge on the current jump-bar item; the position pill. ink-0 text on it is 8.4:1.
base.focus-ring: Focus outline, 2px solid with 2px offset. 5.3:1 on paper-0, so it clears the 3:1 bar for a focus ring on paper. On a coloured band use text-on-ink with an ink halo.
base.space-1: Gap inside a tile; the stamped offset.
base.space-3: Tile padding on a phone; name tab left inset.
base.space-6: Body top padding under a name tab.
base.space-2h: Half-step: name tab and head padding.
base.space-3h: Half-step: how far a name tab hangs above its card.
base.stamped-offset: How far a stamped card shadow sits off the card; the distance the stamp-in travels.
base.tap-min: Minimum hit target; the jump-bar item height.
base.bw-heavy: The stamped edge and the jump-bar item border.
base.radius-md: Legacy sheet card and band corner.
base.shadow-stamped: The stamped card hard offset shadow: no blur, ink, 4px down and right (border-stamped, stamped-offset).
base.shadow-stamped-soft: The shadow under an ink tile (border-stamped-soft).
base.shadow-card: Soft elevation of a legacy sheet card.
base.shadow-raised: Things that leave the page: sheets, popovers.
base.font-body: JetBrains Mono 500: copy, UI and fact values. Design-system change: the app repo has Source Sans 3 here; this system ships none.
base.w-regular: Regular weight (400), copy (JetBrains Mono ships 500 only, so every weight draws 500).
base.w-semibold: Semibold (600): the count tag face and bold runs.
base.kraft-board: Deep kraft of the Game Log passport board (the book-board-kraft cover). Much darker than seal, so paper foil holds AA on it.
base.surface-row-hover: A table row under the pointer (paper-4). The row is shaded, not lifted.

extra.field-outfield: Field illustration, outfield grass (defense alignments, position innings).
extra.allstar-blue: All-Star banner blue, brighter than the paper navy.
extra.allstar-blue-deep: Deeper All-Star blue; also the book-board-blue cover.
extra.seal-deep: Deeper kraft. FLAG: the source value is 8 digits (#97673395, alpha 0x95), probably a typo for #976733; kept exact.
extra.album-board: Game Log stamp album board: the one dark surface in the app. Foils on it are album-foil and album-foil-soft.
extra.album-board-line: Printed rules on the album board, one step lighter than the board.
extra.album-foil: Foil text on the album board (alias of paper-2).
extra.album-foil-soft: Soft foil text on the album board.
extra.ovr-bench: OVR rating tier: bench. Glows on the album board; ink text on top.
extra.ovr-starter: OVR rating tier: starter. Also ovr-up.
extra.ovr-allstar: OVR rating tier: all-star. Also ovr-down.
extra.ovr-frame: Gold frame of the Legend tile (alias of marker).
extra.ovr-up: Up arrow on an OVR change (alias of ovr-starter).
extra.ovr-down: Down arrow on an OVR change (alias of ovr-allstar).
extra.award-ink: Medal-amber text on an award chip.
extra.award-line: Medal-amber border and timeline node for honors.
extra.accent-primary-hover: Filled ink button under a pointer (alias of ink-2).
extra.accent-negative-hover: Filled clay button under a pointer (alias of clay-deep).
extra.seal-cover: The sealed cover fill (alias of seal). Only where a tap can reveal a score.
extra.seal-cover-ink: Text on the sealed cover (alias of seal-ink).
extra.book-board-kraft: Game Log book board, house kraft cover. Foil text is book-board-foil.
extra.book-board-red: Game Log book board, house red cover.
extra.book-board-blue: Game Log book board, house blue cover.
extra.book-board-foil: Paper foil stamped on every book board (alias of text-on-ink).
extra.focus-ring-band: Paper ring of the focus indicator on a coloured band.
extra.focus-ring-band-halo: Ink halo around the band ring; paper and ink are 13.52:1 apart.
extra.winprob-line: Win-probability chart line; white so it holds on any band colour.
extra.arsenal-fastball: Pitch arsenal mix bar, fastball family (chart fill only, no text on it).
extra.arsenal-breaking: Pitch arsenal mix bar, breaking family.
extra.arsenal-offspeed: Pitch arsenal mix bar, offspeed family.
extra.arsenal-other: Pitch arsenal mix bar, other pitches.
extra.heat-fastball: Pitches card fastball bar (alias of arsenal-fastball).
extra.heat-breaking: Pitches card breaking bar (alias of arsenal-breaking).
extra.heat-offspeed: Pitches card offspeed bar (alias of arsenal-offspeed).
extra.heat-other: Pitches card other bar (alias of text-caption).
extra.heat-band: Pitches card header and footer band (alias of accent-primary).
extra.heat-band-ink: Text on the Pitches card band (alias of text-on-ink).
extra.batted-line: Batted-ball mix bar, line drives (field green).
extra.inset-cell: Pressed-into-paper inset shadow for grid cells and revealed values.
extra.shadow-drop-raised: Single-layer form of shadow-raised, for filter: drop-shadow().
extra.ripple-light: Light ring on a lineup-page band texture.
extra.ripple-dark: Dark ring on a lineup-page band texture.
extra.ripple-mask: Mask colour for the band ripple.
extra.sheen-light: Light sheen on a lineup-page band.
extra.sheen-dark: Dark sheen on a lineup-page band.
extra.ring: Soft focus ring shadow, field green at 35%.
extra.ring-band: Focus ring on a coloured band: paper ring with an ink halo.
extra.opacity-disabled: Opacity of every disabled control; the skin stays, only strength drops.
extra.ease-out: Decelerating curve for most UI arrivals and hovers.
extra.ease-stamp: The stamp curve: drops fast, settles with no overshoot. Stamp-in and the press of Button and Pill.
extra.ease-unfold: Softer curve for a menu or panel that opens.
extra.dur-rise: A card or row that comes up as it fades in.
extra.dur-unfold: A menu, rail or panel that opens.
extra.dur-grow: A bar that fills to its value.
extra.dur-draw: A line or track that inks itself.
extra.stagger-step: In a cascade, row n waits n x this step.
extra.dur-stamp-in: The stamp-in: a stamped card drops stamped-offset into its shadow (380ms).
extra.ease-stamp-in: Easing of the stamp-in (alias of ease-stamp).
extra.dur-snappy: Press feedback for controls a touch heavier than dur-fast.
extra.ease-press: The one ease-in: a stamp pushed down, a seal torn off. Never for something appearing.
extra.dur-tear-lead: How far into the tear the panel fade starts.
extra.ease-flip: Symmetric ease-in-out of the card flip.
extra.dur-glide: Scorecard lens: scroll to the next sealed box.
extra.dur-lens-tear: Scorecard lens: seal halves fly off.
extra.dur-turn-out: Scorecard lens: pane leaves at a half handoff.
extra.dur-turn-in: Scorecard lens: pane enters at a half handoff.
extra.seal-texture: Kraft diagonal-hatch tape of a sealed cover. Only where a tap can reveal a score.
extra.hold-texture: Marker-yellow hatch tape for a thing on hold (rehab, postponed).
extra.il-texture: Clay hatch tape for the injured list and a loss card.
extra.win-texture: Field-green hatch tape for a win card (Last 10).
extra.font-display: Barlow Condensed 700: stat values, name tabs, labels, jump-bar items. Uppercase, tracked.
extra.font-mono: JetBrains Mono 500: every figure, tabular. Emphasis in a figure is colour, never weight.
extra.font-read: Lora: sentence-like copy that must read at small sizes (play-by-play).
extra.font-display-tag: Barlow Condensed Tag 600: the card count tag and nothing else.
extra.w-black: Black (900): the slate card @ watermark only.
extra.fs-h3: Jump-bar item; bleed section head title.
extra.fs-label: Condensed uppercase labels: fact label, table head, stat tile label.
extra.fs-field: Text inputs; 16px is the iOS no-zoom floor.
extra.fs-caption: Body-face text too short to be a sentence (a position, a venue).
extra.fs-cell: Mono figure in a cell: tile caption, count badge, rank mark.
extra.fs-score-lg: Stat tile value on a phone.
extra.lh-solid: Name tab, count tag, jump-bar line height.
extra.space-section: Gap between a page top-level sections (16px, alias of space-4).
extra.app-width: Phone-column width every screen is capped to.
extra.control-min: Height of a control inside a card (34px).

flags.graphite-soft: FLAG: 3.10:1 on paper-2 and 2.91:1 on paper-0, under 4.5:1. Kept exact; use only for "not available" placeholders, never a figure.
flags.text-caption: 5.04:1 on paper-0, 5.36:1 on paper-2, 4.52:1 on field-wash (passes by 0.02); on a tint tile use text-muted.
flags.accent-negative: FLAG: 4.37:1 on a picked row (paper-5), under 4.5:1; 4.75:1 on paper-0, 5.05:1 on paper-2. On a picked row use clay-deep (6.33:1).
flags.clay: FLAG: clay text on clay-soft is 4.28:1, under 4.5:1; keep clay text off clay-soft.
